findings: Bounded SMC address/register/data/control port sequence agrees with retained byte-write implementation; completion rejection and finite wait behavior differ intentionally.
Raw timer port 0x8008 agrees with retained TIMER_IO. This comparison does not qualify timer progress or wall-clock timing.
Exporter is called after original display apply and optional post-capture. Marker absence cannot distinguish failure to reach exporter from indication failure.
limits: Static comparison only; no physical signal errors or native statuses recovered.
